question: Which of the following bacterial infections often affects the lungs ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tuberculosis**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tuberculosis** is a bacterial infection caused by *Mycobacterium tuberculosis*.
 
• It primarily affects the lungs but can also impact other parts of the body.
